title: US Bitcoin ETFs lose $582 million on November 19 as BlackRock leads redemptions
why_it_matters: The sharp divergence between IBIT redemptions and MSBT inflows shows that aggregate Bitcoin ETF flows can obscure fund-level differences. November's cumulative withdrawals also highlight pressure on regulated crypto investment products.
caption:
RWA WIRE // CRYPTO MARKET

US Bitcoin ETFs lose $582 million on November 19 as BlackRock leads redemptions

US spot Bitcoin funds recorded roughly $582 million in net withdrawals on November 19, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $541.1 million while Morgan Stanley's MSBT attracted new money.
